question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

When supper was _________, Uncle Jack went to the Livingroom and sat down.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"over" **is commonly used to indicate **that something has ended or is finished.**
 
• The other options ("completed", "finish", "closed") do not fit as naturally in this context.
 
• "Completed" and "closed" might be used in different contexts, but "finish" is not in the correct form ("finished" would be correct).
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "over".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When supper was **over**, Uncle Jack went to the Livingroom and sat down."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "completed"** – This word is grammatically correct but less commonly used in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "finish"** – This is incorrect as it is not in the past tense form "finished".
 
• **Option 3: "closed"** – This word does not fit the context of a meal being finished.
